Chapter 323: Chapter 18: The Great Escape (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

“Xueyou, in the southeastern area you are in, ten minutes from now, at a thirty-degree position to the lower left, there will be a Seventh Rank Human Evolver passing by. Kill him.”

The unicorn man’s gaze was vast, his perception spreading,

as he began to lock onto those human evolvers with strong auras.

The Insect Race’s command to them was to kill as many human evolvers as possible,

The more human evolvers of higher ranks they killed, the more rewards they would be bestowed.

...

…

At the edge of the battlefields of different races.

Lin Yuan transformed into a streak of flowing light, swiftly fleeing towards the outside of the battlefield.

“Didn’t delay even for a moment?”

Lin Yuan glanced behind him, certainly expecting the Suspended Mountain Range to collapse.

Inside, the Seventh Rank Monarch Zhou Shi, likewise did not stir up the slightest ripple.

“If I tried to cover our retreat, it would probably be of no use, right?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the entire Heiyuan Clan had deployed its full strength,

which simply wasn’t something a Seventh Rank Evolver could stop,

even an average Eighth Layer might not last long.

“This is the battlefield of different species.”

“Full of crises, all sorts of situations can arise at any moment…”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat emotional. This time entering the battlefield of different races,

he had been extremely cautious and low-profile, not engaging in battle with any different species.

Yet even so, he’d still ended up in this escape situation.

This was just a small-sized otherworldly battlefield,

if it were a medium, let alone a large alien battlefield, the uncertainties would be even greater,

Powerful beings like the Chikun Star Lord had to be careful and cautious on a large alien battlefield.

“With my speed, if I were to go all out, I could completely approach a Eighth Rank Evolver, or even surpass an average Eighth Rank Evolver…”

At the moment, Lin Yuan was showing a speed that only reached the Sixth Rank Peak,

not even as fast as a Seventh Rank Evolver.

The reason for this was fear,

that showing too great a speed would attract the attention of the Heiyuan Clan’s strong ones.

Like that unicorn man,

if he saw Lin Yuan’s speed reaching the Eighth Layer, would he come after him personally?

So Lin Yuan’s displayed speed was moderately above average among the countless fleeing evolvers.

If the leader Zhou Shi was right that the scattered fleeing human evolvers had an eighty to ninety percent chance of survival,

then Lin Yuan was very likely to escape.

Too much speed makes one stick out and more likely to be targeted.

…

In the southeastern region of the battlefield.

The stocky man Xueyou’s eyes were fierce, leading many of the Heiyuan Clan strong ones to guard the area.

“There’s a group of Fourth and Fifth Rank Evolvers escaping this way… don’t bother with them.”

The stocky man Xueyou’s target was clear.

Killing one Sixth Rank Evolver could secure more bounty from the Insect Race than hundreds of Fourth and Fifth Rank Evolvers.

If they went after that group of Fourth and Fifth Rank Evolvers and missed a Sixth or Seventh Rank Evolver, that would be a real loss.

And with the foundation of human civilization, the death of a few Fourth and Fifth Rank Evolvers is practically negligible.

Considering the current human population, more Fourth and Fifth Rank Evolvers naturally die of old age each day than on the battlefield.

“Hm?”

“There’s a Seventh Rank Evolver escaping this way.”

The stocky man Xueyou’s eyes lit up as he looked into the distance.

Their area was subtly twisted in space, isolated from the outside,

so that human Evolver had no idea there were Heiyuan Clan strong ones ambushed nearby.

“I’ll go.”

“You guys stay here.”

The stocky man Xueyou said,

as an Eighth Layer strong one, he was a sure bet to deal with a Seventh Rank Evolver,

sending their own Seventh Rank could result in being held up or counter-killed.

Eighth Layer against Seventh Rank, the pressure of the Great Realm difference meant no surprises.

Whoosh.

The stocky man Xueyou disappeared.

When he reappeared, he was already directly in front of the fleeing Seventh Rank Evolver.

“Human…”

The stocky man Xueyou looked pitying, “I don’t want to kill you either, but this is the Insect Race’s command.”

Shhh.

Before the fleeing Seventh Rank Evolver even understood what was happening, he was dead at the stocky man’s hands.

It was too easy for Eighth Layer to handle a Seventh Rank.

…

As more Sixth and Seventh Rank Evolvers were intercepted and killed,

many Fourth and Fifth Rank Evolvers managed to escape.

Because of the position of the Suspended Mountain Range, which is not the very center of the battlefield,

it led some evolvers to choose escape directions closer to the battlefield.

Therefore, their escape from the battlefield was naturally quicker.

“I’m about to leave the battlefield…”

Lin Yuan, formed into a meteor, surveilled his surroundings, thinking rapidly.

If he went all out, he could have left the battlefield by now,

but similarly, that might have caught the attention of a more powerful different species, leading to interception.

“Just a little bit longer.”

Lin Yuan maintained a speed close to the Sixth Rank Peak,

as soon as he escapes the battlefield of different species and reaches the stable cosmic starry sky,

he would immediately bring out a cosmic spaceship, perform a wormhole shuttle.

Then, this Taiyin Primordial Spirit would be saved.

“`

…

The southeastern area of the battlefield.

The stocky man, Xueyou, continued to observe his surroundings.

“That human evolver, his speed is close to that of a Sixth Rank Peak, we can’t let him escape alive.”

The stocky man, Xueyou, noticed Lin Yuan and spoke.

“Chang Yu, you go kill him.”

The stocky man, Xueyou, instructed.

His Eighth Layer strength was meant to deal with Human Seventh-Rank Evolvers,

As for Sixth Rank Evolvers? There was no need for that.

They could be left to other Seventh Rank members of the Heiyuan Clan.

Eighth Layer dealing with Seventh Rank, no surprises there.

Seventh Rank dealing with Sixth Rank, just as unsurprising.

Under the suppression of a Great Realm, even the top geniuses of the human civilization could hardly contend.

“Yes.”

“Lord Xueyou, I will take care of this human.”

The Seventh Rank strongman of the Heiyuan Clan, Chang Yu, licked his lips,

killing these human evolvers could garner rewards from the Insect Race,

and even more so, one could obtain the numerous treasures and weapons from the opponent.

In the usual battlefields of different races, they, as Seventh Rank members,

would be entangled by the Seventh Rank Evolvers of human civilization; where was the chance to bully the weak?

Seventh Rank strongman Chang Yu vanished, reappearing directly in front of the direction where Lin Yuan was fleeing.

“Hehe, just die quietly at my hands.”

The Seventh Rank strongman Chang Yu patiently waited there,

waiting for Lin Yuan to enter a certain range before he took action to crush him to death.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred, sensing a change in the atmosphere ahead.

“What to do?”

Lin Yuan’s brows furrowed,

with the sensing range of a Sixth Rank Evolver, he couldn’t detect that Seventh Rank alien.

“Just pretend I don’t know.”

Lin Yuan decided to maintain his escape direction.

After all, once he changed direction, he would be discovered by that Seventh Rank alien,

who could also change direction to block him.

Boom, boom, boom.

His terrifying speed tore through the air.

Soon he would enter the attack range of that Seventh Rank alien.

“Hahaha, human, go die.”

The Seventh Rank alien strongman, Chang Yu, revealed himself, lifting his right hand and slamming it down towards Lin Yuan.

“He should be dead now.”

In the distance, the stocky man Xueyou glanced in this direction, having already pronounced Lin Yuan’s death sentence.

Although Chang Yu’s strength was no match for a Seventh Rank Monarch Evolver of the humans,

wasn’t it a cinch for him to deal with a Sixth Rank Peak Evolver?

…..

“Not good, Brother Yuan is in danger.”

In another direction, the armored man noticed this and his heart suddenly tightened.

He had originally planned to escape with Lin Yuan,

but he didn’t expect Lin Yuan to be so fast; so seeing Lin Yuan set off, he followed suit and fled.

However, the armored man was only trailing behind Lin Yuan,

due to his slower speed, the distance between them grew further and further apart.

Now, they were nearly a million kilometers apart.

“It’s a Seventh Rank alien.”

A chill ran down the armored man’s spine,

with a Seventh Rank alien ambushing ahead, he couldn’t see any way for Lin Yuan to possibly survive.

Boom, boom, boom.

Facing the suddenly appearing Seventh Rank alien.

Lin Yuan’s speed did not slow down in the slightest; he continued to rush forward.

“Hahaha, scared stiff, huh?”

The Heiyuan Clan’s Chang Yu’s face revealed a sneer, thinking Lin Yuan was too afraid to react.

“Die.”

The Seventh Rank alien, Chang Yu, did not hold back and struck Lin Yuan with all his might.

But the next moment.

The air around them suddenly carried wisps of Taiyin power.

The blow delivered by the Seventh Rank alien, Chang Yu, evaporated swiftly under the erosion of the Power of Taiyin.

“Ah?”

The Seventh Rank alien, Chang Yu, blinked, somewhat puzzled.

Boom!

At this moment, Lin Yuan, fleeing at the speed of a Sixth Rank Peak, suddenly surged in speed by tenfold, a hundredfold.

In the blink of an eye, he overpowered the Seventh Rank alien, Chang Yu.

“No—”

The Seventh Rank alien, Chang Yu’s face showed terror as his shape shattered instantly.

Lin Yuan flew past and casually collected his storage treasure.

“What?”

In the distance, the stocky man, Xueyou, looked this way with some disbelief.

“That speed?”

Xueyou’s face changed.

“Hmm?”

In another section of the battlefield, the one-horned man also noticed the scene unfolding here and turned his gaze over.
